falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 cash index closes at least 6.0% below its signal-date close within the next 14 calendar days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breakdown of that size resolves the unknown phase as risk-off and proves HOLD wrong; the 76% bottom_2024_aug match would be invalidated, not merely unconfirmed.

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 5.0% above its signal-date close and CBOE VIX closes below 14.0 on the same session within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A price thrust plus vol crush would confirm the bottom analog and force a risk-on call, falsifying both UNKNOWN and HOLD.

falsification_conditions.condition: ICE BofA US High Yield OAS widens by 75 basis points or more versus its signal-date level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A credit-spread blowout of that size would show the blowoff score of 41 and the bottom-pattern match were misleading, invalidating a neutral hold in favor of stress.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
